mordrath.desc: Mordrath, the Pale Sovereign (boss 8x): bone-white plate (the only plate in the arc) with gold-black trim, crown of red cold fire, violet-smoke wings (cape; smoke = fx), chains of names on the arms, tall pale glaive. P1 (100-60%): glaive sweeps (violet arc tell), name-chains (red floor line).

mordrath_p2.desc: Mordrath, the Pale Sovereign (boss 8x): bone-white plate (the only plate in the arc) with gold-black trim, crown of red cold fire, violet-smoke wings (cape; smoke = fx), chains of names on the arms, tall pale glaive. P2 (60-25%): hunts (red ring + lunge), calls 2 shades + 1 soul_wraith; the dome dims.

mordrath_p3.desc: Mordrath, the Pale Sovereign (boss 8x): bone-white plate (the only plate in the arc) with gold-black trim, crown of red cold fire, violet-smoke wings (cape; smoke = fx), chains of names on the arms, tall pale glaive. P3 (25-0%): pulls names to heal (violet motes), crown flares (red half-arena ring); crown taller, gold trim burns red.
